_comment: This file is a Sphinx documentation configuration file (conf.py) for the GTN project. It contains configuration variables and a single setup callback. There are no callable APIs, classes, or functions intended for external use or CLI invocation. No meaningful tool-use examples can be generated from this file.
review_sphinx_conf: review the sphinx conf.py configuration for the GTN documentation project
